description: Export a SocialSeal report. Use reportType search_results_enriched, format csv and payload.groupIds for ranked search results; reuse the workspace from the group lookup. Poll socialseal_get_tool_status with kind=export and the returned export ID while pending, then fetch download_url or page socialseal_read_export_chunk with read_token until has_more is false; pages read before has_more is false cover part of the export. The completed result carries evidenceNotes on reading the rows. Rows are videos surfaced for the selected queries at capture time, not search volume or total market demand. Region is the collection market, not verified viewer geography. Views, likes and saves are per-video engagement snapshots, not engagement attributable to the query.
